Item Class: Waystones
Rarity: Rare
Arcane Path
Waystone (Tier 15)
--------
Item Rarity: +14% (augmented)
Item Level: 82
--------
{ Prefix Modifier "Fleeting" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 15(10-15)% increased Attack, Cast and Movement Speed
{ Prefix Modifier "Destructive" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 235(200-240)% increased Critical Hit Chance
Monsters have +23(21-25)% Critical Damage Bonus
{ Prefix Modifier "Tough" (Tier: 1) }
25(20-25)% more Monster Life
{ Prefix Modifier "Venomous" (Tier: 1) }
Monsters have 32(27-33)% chance to Poison on Hit
{ Suffix Modifier "of Exposure" (Tier: 1) }
-7(-8--6)% maximum Player Resistances
{ Suffix Modifier "of the Prism" (Tier: 1) }
+31(30-34)% Monster Elemental Resistances
{ Suffix Modifier "of Drought" (Tier: 1) }
Players gain 32(35-30)% reduced Flask Charges
{ Suffix Modifier "Flaming" (Tier: 1) }
Area has patches of Ignited Ground
--------
Can be used in a Map Device, allowing you to enter a Map. Waystones can only be used once.
